articles.title: Apple sues OpenAI and two former employees, accusing them of trade secrets theft
articles.description: Apple on Friday filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and two former employees, alleging misappropriation of the iPhone maker’s trade secrets to benefit the ChatGPT-owner’s foray into consumer hardware.
